note: Local AI coders that run on the TENET5 host — each is a specialized role inside the liril_dev_team pipeline. Every coder uses the same base model (Mistral-Nemo-Instruct-2407-Q4_K_M on RTX 5070 Ti) plus an optional role-specific LoRA adapter trained on captured corrections. When a coder's output is rejected by the gatekeeper or diff-audit, the rejection becomes a training example. Over time the coders should need fewer corrections for the same task domain.

coders.responsibilities: Reads primary sources (Canada Gazette, Hansard, Commissioner reports, court filings via CanLII). Identifies one specific, citable fact needed for the task. Outputs SOURCE + QUOTE + GAP_FILLED triple.
Decides where in the 19-axis / IA-pillar layout a change belongs. Outputs FILE + ANCHOR + POSITION.
Proposes UX/visual form (card / inline paragraph / list item / badge) + accessibility (ARIA/alt/contrast) + copy tone following Shneiderman, NN/g, WCAG.
Produces the literal fenced-code-block content to insert. No explanation, no narration — only the change itself.
Copy-checks the engineer output. CHECK_CITATIONS / CHECK_LINKS / CHECK_A11Y + OVERALL: CLEAN | NEEDS_REWORK.
Hallucination gate. Returns VERDICT: PASS | WATCH | FAIL + REASON. PASS commits; WATCH/FAIL triggers rework.
known_failure_modes: False-positive PASS: gatekeeper can PASS a pipeline whose engineer role produced NOTHING, because the upstream text outputs sound coherent. See cycle WS-001_1776489500: PASS with no file change. Mitigated by the liril_dev_team downgrade rule (engineer pipeline + no apply = PASS→WATCH), but the gatekeeper itself should learn to detect 'pipeline produced no concrete deliverable' as a FAIL condition.

training_loop.capture: Every role's output is logged to data/liril_dev_team_log/<task>_<ts>.json at cycle time.
training_loop.annotate: Corrections land in data/liril_corrections.jsonl via tools/liril_correct.py. Each entry: role, task_id, role_input, bad_output, correction, annotation.
training_loop.compile: tools/liril_build_training_set.py collects corrections per role → models/loras/<role>/train.jsonl in OpenAI chat format.
training_loop.train: tools/liril_train_lora.py runs unsloth fine-tuning on the RTX 5070 Ti when ≥50 examples accumulated for a role. Requires GPU.
training_loop.deploy: Registry status flips from 'base' to 'tuned-v1' with lora_path. Dev-team daemon loads the LoRA adapter for that role via llama-server --lora flag.

gpu_budget.note: Training pauses inference. Only schedule when the dev-team daemon is idle.
